text: If a vector $\bvec$ is a linear combination of an orthogonal set of vectors $\wvec_1,\wvec_2,\ldots,\wvec_n$, then $$ \bvec = \frac{\bvec\cdot\wvec_1}{\wvec_1\cdot\wvec_1}\wvec_1 + \frac{\bvec\cdot\wvec_2}{\wvec_2\cdot\wvec_2}\wvec_2 + \cdots + \frac{\bvec\cdot\wvec_n}{\wvec_n\cdot\wvec_n}\wvec_n\text{.} $$
